He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]]. He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2025 class. He holds Italian citizenship through his mother.{{Cite web |date=2026-06-22 |title=Storie e curiosità dei giocatori al Draft 2026 |url=https://sport.sky.it/nba/2026/06/22/draft-nba-2026-storie-curiosita-giocatori |access-date=2026-07-12 |website=sport.sky.it |language=it}} ==Early life and high school career== Ament grew up in [[Manassas, Virginia]] and initially attended [[Charles J. Colgan Sr. High School|Colgan High School]].{{cite web |url=https://www.si.com/college/virginia/basketball/virginia-offers-four-star-forward-nate-ament-no-1-in-state-recruit |title=Virginia Offers team during his freshman season and scored 53 total points.{{cite web|url=https://www.insidenova.com/sports/prince_william/colgan-s-nate-ament-ready-for-a-breakout-season/article_acbc6dd6-6774-11ed-99fe-e779a1983cbc.html|title=Colgan's Nate Ament ready for a web|url=https://www.insidenova.com/sports/nate-ament-and-the-rise-of-highland-boys-basketball/article_2f574b1e-7339-11ee-a655-a3b26e634a3d.html|title=Nate Ament and the rise of Highland boys basketball|first=Dave|last=Fawcett|website=InsideNoVa.com|date=October 27, 2023|access-date=October 1, 2024}} After his sophomore year Ament transferred to the [[Highland School (Warrenton, Virginia)|Highland School]] in [[Warrenton, Virginia]].{{cite web |last=Fawcett |first=David |date=August 30, 2023 |title=Top-rated basketball recruit Nate Ament transfers to Warrenton's Highland School |url=https://www.fauquiernow.com/news/features_events/top-rated-basketball-recruit-nate-ament-transfers-to-warrentons-highland-school/article_4d643f23-78f7-5fed-831d-de143e1a782e.html |access-date=September 27, 2024 |website=Fauquier Now}} He averaged 19.3 points, 7.8 rebounds, four blocks and 3.7 assists per game in his first season at Highland.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/louisville/basketball/nate-ament-offered|title=Louisville Offers Top-20 '25 Prospect Nate Ament|first=Matthew|last=McGavic|website=[[SI.com]]|date=April 23, 2024|access-date=October 16, 2024}} During his senior year, he signed a shoe deal with [[Reebok]].{{cite web|url=https://www.insidenova.com/sports/prince_william/manassas-resident-and-highland-school-basketball-player-nate-ament-signs-deal-with-reebok/article_c2932654-8bf8-11ef-9b08-a33608ebce1b.html|title=Manassas resident Nate Ament signs deal with Reebok|website=InsideNoVa.com|date=October 16, 2024|access-date=October 17, 2024}} Ament was named the 2024–25 Virginia boys' basketball Gatorade Player of the Year.{{Cite web |last=Van De Griek |first=Ross |date=March 21, 2025 |title=Nate Ament wins Virginia high school basketball Gatorade player of the year school=Tennessee}} ==College career== Ament averaged 16.7 points and 6.3 rebounds per game as a freshman, helping Tennessee reach the Elite Eight of the NCAA tournament. He was named to the Second Team [[List of All-SEC men's basketball teams|All-SEC]]. Following the season he declared for the [[2026 NBA draft]].{{cite web |title=Tennessee forward Nate Ament declares for NBA draft after 1 season |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/48575849|website=[[ESPN]] |access-date=May 13, 2026 |date=April 23, 2026|others=Contributed by The Associated Press}} ==Professional career== On June 23, 2026, Ament was selected with the thirteenth overall pick by the [[Miami Heat]] in the [[2026 NBA Draft]]. On July 6, 2026, Ament, alongside [[Tyler Herro]], [[Kasparas Jakučionis]], [[Jaime Jaquez Jr.]], [[Kel'el Ware]] and four more future draft picks, was traded to the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] in exchange for [[Giannis Antetokounmpo]] and [[Bobby Portis]].{{Cite web |date=July 6, 2026 |title=Heat acquire Giannis Antetokounmpo in blockbuster deal |url=https://www.nba.com/news/reports-heat-acquire-giannis-antetokounmpo-in-blockbuster-deal |access-date=July 6, 2026 |website=NBA.com |language=en}} ==National team career== Ament played for the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2024 FIBA U18 AmeriCup]].{{cite web|url=https://www.fauquiernow.com/news/features_events/highlands-nate-ament-wins-a-gold-medal/article_e67226d5-d4be-51c3-b1e9-c13e265de84b.html|title=Highland's Nate Ament wins a gold medal|website=Fauquier Now|date=June 10, 2024|access-date=September 27, 2024}} He averaged 3.7 points and 1.5 rebounds per game as the United States won the gold medal.{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/college/kentucky/article/nate-ament-kentucky-basketball-recruiting-offer--232999494/|title=Kentucky offers 5-star forward|first=Chris|last=Fisher|website=[[247Sports]]|date=June 18, 2024|access-date=September 30, 2024}} ==Personal life== Ament's father, Albert, played [[college basketball]] at [[Wayne State Warriors|Wayne State]].{{cite web|url=https://247sports.com/article/2025-sf-nate-ament-breaks-out-as-a-national-prospect-210260833/|title=2025 SF Nate Ament breaks out as a national prospect|first=Travis|last=Branham|website=[[247Sports]]|date=May 15, 2023|access-date=October 17, 2024}} His mother, Godelive, is a native of [[Rwanda]] and met Albert while he was working for [[Catholic Relief Services]] and both were taking part in relief efforts in the aftermath of the [[Rwandan genocide|genocide against Tutsis in Rwanda]].{{cite web|url=https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/19391/sports/basketball/nate-ament-youngster-with-rwandan-roots-ranked-among-usas-basketball-finest|title=Nate Ament: Youngster with Rwandan roots ranked among USA's basketball finest|first=Damas|last=Sikubwabo|work=[[The New Times (Rwanda)|The New Times]]|date=August 21, 2024|access-date=October 17, 2024}} His mother lived in Italy, where she was adopted and became an Italian citizen. Since 2025, Ament has been in a relationship with [[Jazzy Davidson]], who plays collegiate basketball for the [[USC Trojans women's basketball|USC Trojans]].{{Cite web |last=AlBaroudi |first=Wajih |title=NBA Draft: Who is Nate Ament's girlfriend? Meet USC star Jazzy Davidson |url=https://ftw.usatoday.com/story/sports/nba/2026/06/23/nba-draft-nate-ament-girlfriend-jazzy-davidson-tennessee-usc-instagram/90664687007/ |website=For The Win |publisher=[[USA Today]] |date=2026-06-23 |access-date=2026-06-24 |language=en-US }} Ament is a [[Christianity|Christian]]. He has worn the jersey number 10 as a nod to the Bible verse Isaiah 41:10. He has said, "To be able to lean on your faith in times of trouble and knowing that—win or lose, good performance or bad performance—Jesus is always going to be here with me kind of just allows me to play more free, more confident. Just trusting in God and not leaning on my own understanding."{{cite web |last=Claybourn |first=Cole |title=Nate Ament goes No. 13 to Milwaukee Bucks in NBA Draft knowing ‘God is my strength’ |url=https://sportsspectrum.com/sport/basketball/2026/06/24/nate-ament-13-milwaukee-bucks-nba-draft-god-strength/ |website=Sports Spectrum |access-date=2026-06-27|date=2026-06-24}} ==Career statistics== {{NBA player statistics legend}} ===College=== {{NBA player statistics start}} |- | style="text-align:left;"| [[2025–26 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2025–26]] | style="text-align:left;"| [[2025–26 Tennessee Volunteers basketball team|Tennessee]] | 35 || 35 || 29.7 || .399 || .333 || .790 || 6.3 || 2.3 || 1.0 || .6 || 16.7 {{s-end}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://utsports.com/sports/mens-basketball/roster/nate-ament/22161 Tennessee Volunteers bio] *[https://www.usab.com/players/nate-ament USA Basketball bio] {{Milwaukee Bucks current roster}} {{2026 NBA draft}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ament, Nate}} [[Category:2006 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:21st-century Italian sportsmen]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:American people of Rwandan descent]] [[Category:Basketball players from Virginia]] [[Category:Italian people of Rwandan descent]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Miami Heat draft picks]] [[Category:Power forwards]] [[Category:Tennessee Volunteers basketball players]]
